title: Account-scoped EU residency policy evaluator and fallback selector
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement an account-scoped policy evaluator that enforces EU-only data residency at request-evaluation time and selects a graceful fallback model variant when constraints cannot be met. This ticket covers: policy precedence (account allow/deny overrides, org policies, global defaults), routing decision latency budget, audit logging for compliance, and a configurable fallback selector that prefers compatible model variants in allowed regions or lower-tier quantized variants with preserved privacy guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: Policy evaluator returns definitive routing decision within 20ms P95 for requests not requiring expensive lookups
Account-level allowlist and denylist are respected and take precedence over org/global defaults

When no EU-hosted model capacity is available, system chooses a fallback model variant per policy (order: EU-compatible variant in adjacent EU region -> EU-quantized shard -> customer-visible 429 with remediation guidance)
All routing decisions are recorded to audit log stream with reason, final_route, policy_version, and decision_path
E2E test harness simulates 1000 requests/min across mixed account policies and validates routing outcomes and latency SLOs
decisions: Use account-scoped metadata (account_id + residency_flag) as first-class input to policy evaluator to avoid tenant lookups on hot path
Fallback selector will prefer 'region-compatible' model variants over cross-border routing to non-EU regions unless explicit customer opt-in exists
Implement soft-fallback (telemetry + annotated response) for beta customers to avoid hard rejections during rollout
Audit logs will be written to a dedicated compliance Kafka topic and mirrored to Cloud Storage for retention policies
implementation_plan: Schema: extend routing decision proto to include decision_path and policy_version
Policy cache: add in-memory account policy cache with TTL 5m + invalidation hook on policy change events
Evaluator: implement precedence engine (account allowlist -> account denylist -> org policy -> global default)
Fallback selector: implement ordered candidate pipeline with scoring (compliance_score, latency_estimate, cost_estimate)
Integrations: hook audit log writes into existing observability pipeline and add trace spans for decision execution
Feature flag: rollout under 'account_eu_residency_v1' with canary percentage config
